question: The ability of metals to be drawn into thin wires is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**ductility.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ductility**__ is the ability of a material to be drawn or plastically deformed without fracture.
 
• It is the ability of metals to be drawn into thin wires.&l
